title: Integrated Pest Management guidance
claim: Integrated Pest Management, which uses monitoring-based thresholds and biological controls before chemical treatment, reduces pesticide inputs and the associated harm to non-target species and downstream water quality.
evidence_text: FAO's Integrated Pest Management framework promotes monitoring-based decision thresholds, crop rotation, resistant varieties, and biological control agents as alternatives to routine calendar-based pesticide spraying. By reducing overall and non-targeted chemical applications, IPM lowers off-target mortality of pollinators and soil organisms and reduces agrochemical runoff into adjacent soil and water systems.
